name: Step 3.5 Flash
title: Step 3.5 Flash: price, context window and specs
answer: Step 3.5 Flash is a model in StepFun's StepFun Step family, first listed on 2026-01-29. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 262K tokens and up to 65K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.3 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
compare: It is the oldest of the 3 versions of StepFun Step still listed.
Its input price is below the family median of $0.2 per million tokens.
